name: compose-graphics
title_zh: Compose 里跑 AGSL 着色器
tagline_zh: 别等 Android 16 了。现在就用 Material 3 Expressive 的物理弹簧和碎片着色器。
tagline_en: Don't wait for Android 16. Get Material 3 Expressive springs & fragment shaders on Canvas now — no OpenGL detour.
desc_en: Advanced Compose visuals - Material 3 Expressive motion physics, AGSL shaders (Android 13+), Canvas/DrawScope generative, graphicsLayer effects.
why_zh: 把 AGSL 着色器封装成可组合的 DrawScope 扩展，Motion 物理参数直接调。
why_en: Wraps AGSL shaders as DrawScope extensions with tweakable Motion physics — no GL threads or matrix math on your side.
limit_zh: 只认 Android 13+ 真机或模拟器（API 33+），AGSL 在 API 32 以下直接崩。
limit_en: Android 13+ (API 33+) only — AGSL crashes below. No Compose Multiplatform, no iOS/desktop targets.
title_en: Run AGSL shaders & Motion physics in Compose
